name: X Bioscience Public Company Limited
summary: X Bioscience Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, sells food and beverages in Thailand. It engages in the food and beverage investment and restaurant businesses. The company also manufactures and sells biological products, as well as generates and transmits electric power. Its brands include Kagonoya, Le Boeuf, and Bake Cheese Tart. The company was formerly known as Wow Factor Public Company Limited and changed its name to X Bioscience Public Company Limited in January 2025. X Bioscience Public Company Limited was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand.
